description: Teams integrity-bypass patch bundle (demo build, from rushiranpise/morphe-patches). Includes CodeTransparency / OneAuth cert / MSAL redirect-URI bypasses plus Privacy Enhancements.

patches.name: Desktop User-Agent for Login
patches.description: Spoofs the WebView user agent to a desktop Chrome user agent during Microsoft login, allowing login as a desktop client instead of mobile. Works with conditional access policies that block mobile user agents.

patches.name: Privacy Enhancements
patches.description: Suppresses outbound read receipts and prevents admin quiet-hours policies from overriding your presence status.
